aggregation: Equal combination means after averaging repeated experiments within each pair/combination. SD ddof=1 across combinations.

historical_comparison.scope: All available historical summary rows, including single-agent Hard and dual-agent noise; single-agent conditions pooled.

non_hard_comparison: Both systems restricted to the same 16 domain/scenario combinations; Hard and noise excluded.

limitations: Historical summaries only; different cohorts, no verified question pairing or pooled prediction-level calibration.
